method: Static trigger-boundary review; runtime selection is recorded separately when available.

cases.prompt: Review the saved Terraform plan for our staging DNS stack and tell me whether it is safe to apply.
Implement a bounded Terraform tag change in this module, validate it locally, and do not apply it.
Investigate why this OpenTofu stack shows drift from its managed resources.
Plan how to import this existing resource into the declared Terraform address without changing infrastructure.
Review this proposed terraform state mv procedure, including backup and recovery.
Restart nginx on the managed Linux server and verify its health.
Explain what Terraform is at a high level.
Edit Docker Compose directly on the server and restart the container.
Discuss a general multi-cloud architecture; there is no IaC repository or artifact yet.
